test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

The playwright borrowed the ________ (crux) of plot from Shakespeare.
solution: The correct answer is: **Essence** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Crux **means the most important or essential part of something. (किसी चीज़ का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण या आवश्यक भाग) • **Example**: *The crux of the matter is that communication is key.* • Marked option **Essence **means the intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something. (किसी चीज़ की आंतरिक प्रकृति या अपरिहार्य गुण) • **Example**: *The essence of the story is the relationship between the two main characters.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Peel **means to remove the outer layer of something. (किसी चीज़ की बाहरी परत को हटाना) • **Subsistence **means the minimum amount of resources needed for survival. (जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक संसाधनों की न्यूनतम मात्रा) • **Blueprint **means a detailed plan or design. (एक विस्तृत योजना या डिज़ाइन) 3c:T987, The correct answer is: **Flaw**
